title: add profiling baselines, representative workload runners, and reporting pipeline
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: consolidate profiling baselines, add representative workload runners, and wire up a reporting pipeline so perf metrics are reproducible and consumable by the Benchmark Lab dashboards. This PR contains three coordinated changes: 1) a set of profiling baseline configs and scripts that produce reproducible kernel/trace artifacts; 2) representative workload runners for text-generation, chat, and embedding workloads that mirror production traffic patterns; 3) a reporting pipeline that ingests runner outputs, normalizes metrics (p50/p90/p99 latency, throughput, memory, token cost), and writes artifacts to the perf S3 bucket + produces a summarized JSON for the dashboard. Summary of changes: added baseline profiling configs (profiling/baselines/*), new runners under runners/representative/*, adaptor scripts and a lightweight ingestion job under pipeline/ingest/*. Added CI integration tests that run a short smoke on GH actions and a nightly perf job that uploads to the reporting pipeline. Updated README and docs with usage and onboarding steps. Checklist: - [x] Add baseline configs and runner code - [x] Add ingestion/normalization pipeline and S3 writer - [x] Add unit and integration smoke tests - [x] Add docs + quickstart for on-prem reproducible runs - [x] Wire Linear tickets and validate with perf team Testing and validation: local end-to-end smoke runs included in ci/workflows/perf-smoke.yml. Nightly pipeline tested against staging S3 (bucket: perf-lab-staging) and validated with the Benchmark Lab dashboard team. Performance numbers are stored in perf-outputs/{date}/summary.json; sample artifacts included in testdata/ for reviewers. Migration notes: existing ad-hoc runners can be deprecated after one full week of nightly runs from these representative runners. No breaking API changes. Documentation updated with deprecation timeline. Rollout: merged to main; nightly job scheduled in the GH Actions cron (pipeline/nightly-perf.yml). Links: Linear ENG-8421 (profiling baselines), ENG-8473 (reporting pipeline); support ticket SUP-312 included for S3 access coordination.
